description: The § 170(p) non-itemizer deduction is figured 'without regard to subsections (b)(1)(G)(ii), (b)(1)(I), and (d)(1)' — the carryovers and the 0.5% floor — so the (b)(1)(G)(i) limit of 60% of the contribution base still applies. TY2026 single: wages $1,000, cash gifts $1,500 → 60% × $1,000 = $600 (under the $1,000 cap).
